sections.title: Police Career
content: Experienced detective with Regional Police
Known for thorough investigations
Occasionally bends rules to build cases
Has history of aggressive tactics

sections.title: The Investigation
content: Discovered Titovsky's drug smuggling network
Traced connection to Young Conquerors being used as smugglers
Specifically investigating Hal Cyon and Peni Tenz
Getting close to exposing the operation

coreTraits: Sometimes uses excessive force to get results
More by-the-book than Veckurius, but willing to bend rules for the case
motivations: Professional pride in solving difficult investigations

details: Recognized as threat to Titovsky's operation
Zekovich decided to eliminate and frame him
Doesn't know Zekovich is behind the attack until later
Investigating them as part of smuggling network
This information becomes crucial when he wakes
They review his cases after he's hospitalized
They discover he was being framed, not actually corrupt
He provides them with crucial information when he wakes

sections.title: The Victim
content: Ambushed by Zekovich at Hal/Titovsky meeting
Zekovich didn't anticipate him being there
Seriously wounded, put in medically induced coma

sections.title: The Frame Job
content: While comatose, Zekovich plants forged reports
Made to look like he was taking bribes, covering up crimes
Reports use his stolen signature but Zekovich's handwriting
Nearly destroys his reputation

sections.title: The False Lead
content: Sek/Veckurius initially think the case is about his corruption
Discovery that he's being framed shifts investigation
Handwriting analysis reveals Zekovich as forger

sections.title: The Key Witness
content: Wakes from coma in Chapter 5
Immediately arrested by corrupt Judge Muliera's order
Tells Sek/Veckurius: was investigating Hal and Peni Tenz
Reveals Peni was working with Hal in smuggling network
This information leads them to Young Conquerors connection

skillsAndAbilities: Willing to use force when necessary

notableMoments.description: Ambushed and wounded at Hal/Titovsky meeting
Names Peni Tenz as involved with Hal

remarksAndAwards.original: Ukor za prekomjernu stetu pocinjenu tokom policijske akcije
remarksAndAwards.translation: Reprimand for excessive damage during police operation

storySignificance: His investigation sets the plot in motion
Being framed creates the initial mystery
His testimony redirects investigation to Young Conquerors
Represents dedicated cop caught in conspiracy

thematicRole.description: Corrupt judge can arrest innocent cop
Even wounded and framed, provides key information
Was doing his job, paid the price

characterFunction: Red Herring: Initially seems like corrupt cop
Victim: Shows stakes of crossing the conspiracy
aftermath: Presumably cleared of false charges after truth revealed
Lost time in hospital and jail during investigation
May feel guilt for not stopping the smuggling network sooner
Potential role in Book 2 cleaning up aftermath
